name: @tradrl/execution_sim
description: Reference execution simulator implementing @tradrl/execution-policy's contract: approved intents drive a scripted venue (an exchange-sim engine mirror — book-walk matching with fees/latency/slippage/impact configs), refused intents never reach the venue, decisions + fills + audit trail are append-only chain-verified logs, the run state is resumable (serialize -> parse -> resume), the reference policy declares every check dimension, and the fixtures trip each refusal path in order (Work Order T019).
